GOOD MORNING TRADERS ☀️ WELCOME TO OCTOBER

New month, fresh start. And before the charts open today, I want you to do one thing: take 5 minutes and write down your goals for October. Not in your head. On paper or in your notes app, where you'll see them again.

Keep it concrete. Not "make more money" but something like "start copy trading this week", "finish two course modules", "stop checking my phone first thing in the morning". Small enough that you can actually do it, clear enough that on October 31st you know if you did. 🔼

I still do this every month, even now. It's a habit from the years when I had nothing, and it's one of the reasons I have what I have today.

Write them down, save them, and let's make this month count 💯

🌍 Leader sends message to 33rd National Prayer Conference

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Leader of the Islamic Revolution Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei has issued a message to the 33rd National Prayer Conference, stressing the importance of establishing and promoting prayer as a prerequisite for building an Islamic society.

The 33rd National Prayer Conference opened in Mashhad on Thursday with a message from Ayatollah Sayyid Mojtaba Khamenei, delivered near the holy shrine of Imam Reza (PBUH).
​
In his message to the conference, the Leader emphasized the importance of prayer and called on families, teachers and professors, intellectuals, public figures and cultural institutions to play a greater role in promoting prayer in society.
​
The full text of the message of the Leader of Iran on the occasion of the 33rd National Prayer Conference is as follows:
​

​
Paying heed to the sublime matter of "establishing prayer" (iqamat al-salat) – and in particular, holding the National Prayer Conference – is one of the necessary, imperative measures that has taken shape in the country since the early 1370s AHS (1990s).  This achievement is due to the dedicated efforts of the mujahid, people-oriented scholar, teacher of the Quran, and accomplished preacher, Hujjat al-Islam wal-Muslimeen Qara'ati (may his successes continue).
​
The special attention that our exalted, martyred Leader (may God elevate his noble station), devoted to this matter along with his important, continuous, emphatic recommendations in his messages to the 32 conferences held thus far further calls attention to the importance of this course of action.
​
Undoubtedly, speaking or writing about prayer is a matter befitting of divine revelation and the words of the Holy Prophet (pbuh) and the Infallible Imams (pbut). The pen of someone like myself is far too humble to write anything regarding the profound depths of the spiritual teachings of prayer. However, the identity and requirements of an Islamic society, and the duties of those who serve it – particularly the Leader of the Islamic Revolution – make it necessary for me to remind myself, the people at large, and also our officials of a few points in this regard.
​
Prayer (salat) is one of the most beautiful of the magnificent blessings bestowed by God, the Glorious and Exalted. It is the supreme institution, symbol, and pillar of religion, serving as the connecting thread that allows each of us to establish a close, direct connection with the infinite, eternal divine source.
​
This elixir of salvation and prosperity, accompanied by the foundation of a life of spiritual purity (hayat tayyibah), serves as both a solid, continuous support and an inexhaustible spiritual reserve for human beings in the struggle against the devil within (nafs) and the devils of the world. It is also a flowing spring of love, hope, kindness, and tranquility. The descent of blessings and an abundance of divine provisions come and increase by establishing prayer and seeking forgiveness.
​
However, the obligation of prayer is not merely an individual duty. According to the teachings of the Quran, establishing prayer is the first outcome and sign of righteous governance, as affirmed in the verse, “[They are] those who, if We grant them authority in the land, establish prayer ...” (Quran 22:41).

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Foreign Minister Seyyed Abbas Araghchi has categorically rejected allegations by British Prime Minister Burnham that Iran was involved in an incident at the Royal Air Force (RAF) Fairford base.

In a post on his X on Thursday, Araghchi reacted to the British prime minister’s remarks, writing that PM Burnham said the UK government “can confirm our belief that we believe Iran to have played a part” in the RAF Fairford incident.
​
“I can confirm Iran's belief that releasing supposed terrorists working for foreign states really says it all,” he said.

“You're barking up the wrong tree,” the Iranian foreign minister added.
